usage.finalMessage:
I added the `quote <customer> <amount>` command and listed it in `help` right after `invoice`. It uses the 21-day payment terms in force (DEC-B12), so `quote c1 100.00` on 2026-03-02 gives `payable by 2026-03-23`. All 7 tests in `dotnet test Billing.slnx` pass, and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
Open question: `invoice` still uses the old 30-day terms (DEC-B01, kept in place by the existing tests), so a quote and an invoice on the same day show different dates. Finance needs to decide whether `invoice` should move to 21 days.

OUTCOME: completed
